_about: The one configuration of every number that moves a rating (Carta rating v5, Roadmap/2.10b-rating-v5.md; batch R1, T754). The pipeline reads it through pipeline/rating_config.py; the app will read it in T776. What was measured on the reference catalogue (zlog spread, breakpoints, class scales, curves, fallback coefficients) lives in the frozen reference named below, never here. Changing a number here is a model change: bump version, then rebuild the reference with apply_rating_layer.py --recalibrate --version <new>.

reference_versions._about: Which version of each part of the frozen reference this config reads. A part is rebuilt only by its own --recalibrate, which must name the version given here; a model change that does not touch a part leaves it at its version (turning depth.live or beauty.live on changes the rating part, not the significance part). T761 adds nature (pipeline/nature_tiers.py) and re-measures rating (depth reads the one POI category set); T762 adds taste (pipeline/place_taste_profile.py); beauty holds the frozen gem cutoffs (apply_beauty_layer.py, T754-e).

formula_about: v5 (T759): Q = weights_v5 over appeal A (hand score, else rubric score, both through the per-class appeal_scale), beauty B (v2), depth D and recognition R, for every place. A place with neither a hand nor a rubric score takes the frozen fallback estimate, confidence estimated, capped at estimated.cap. v4 keeps the weights below, highlights and the modelled/provisional confidence: set formula to v4 (and depth.live, beauty.live to false) to roll back.

weights_v5._about: Carta rating v5 (Roadmap/2.10b-rating-v5.md, Layer 1): Q = 0.60 A + 0.15 B + 0.15 D + 0.10 R, each part on 0 to 10.

class_curve._about: Formula v5 (T759, owner decision 2026-10-27): the blended Q runs below the appeal scale (beauty, depth and recognition sit low on a raw 0 to 10 scale for an ordinary place), so each class reads Q through its own frozen curve: the lowest Q maps to the class's lowest appeal, the median Q to the median appeal, the Q at the top top_share to top_score, the highest Q to the class ceiling (appeal_scale.class_ceiling). Monotone, so the order is Q's; measured once on --recalibrate and stored in the reference.

estimated._about: A place with no hand and no rubric score: shown as estimated and capped below Exceptional until a rubric session scores it.

bands._about: The five v5 band words and their lower cutoffs (owner decision 2026-10-27). Not on the wire yet: tier keeps tiers.cutoffs until T763 moves the app.

weights._about: Destination score blend of formula v4 (rating_v4 weights). Read only when formula is v4.

hidden_gem._about: Rated high AND in the low-fame tail (fame percentile read on the frozen fame breakpoints), or curated as a gem.

recognition._about: Register weights, 0 to 1. The best register counts in full; each further one (up to extra_max) closes extra x its weight of the remaining gap. Keyed by designation kind, or by registry id where a registry has its own weight (geoparks and biosphere reserves were filed as national parks until T754).

depth._about: D, depth (T756), Live from T759 (owner decision 2026-10-27, closes T756-a) under formula v5. How much there is to do. POIs at rate 3 (must_see) and rate 2 (recommended), plus rated nature items (beaches, lakes, peaks, hikes, cycling routes) scored at least nature_min_score between beauty's setting_km and reach_km (about 30 minutes by road: 25 km straight x 1.3 detour at 65 km/h). Sorted into the eight categories of poi_categories; within a category the i-th item counts its weight / i, up to per_category_max (a POI's weight is also scaled by its absolute significance sig / 3 when poi_weight_by_sig: rate is a town-relative quota, so every 52-POI metro holds about six rate-3 items whatever they are); each category covered adds category_bonus. The raw sum is read as a percentile on the frozen per-class breakpoints and written to rating.components.highlights (the key is renamed in schema v19, T775). Rate is derived from the POI label (poi_labels, T761).

poi_own_km._about: T759 (owner decision 2026-10-27): a POI counts for a place only within this distance of its centre, by class; the POI lists reach into neighbouring towns (Begunje counted Bled at 10 km). null counts every POI the list holds (an area is a landscape you base yourself in).

depth.categories_from: poi_categories (T761, closes T756-c): the one category set the POI labels carry; the name patterns are gone

beauty._about: Beauty v2 (T756), live from T759 (owner decision 2026-10-27, closes T756-a) under formula v5. What you see within setting_km of the centre. An item scored item_floor is worth 0 and item_floor + item_span is worth 1; the best item counts in full and the second closes second_item_share of the gap. Keys follow the wire: nature = natural setting, beach = water (renamed in schema v19). heritage stays measured for the culture match but weighs 0: UNESCO is counted in recognition.

highlights._about: rating_v4 highlights, live until depth.live is turned on: 0.55 x best sight + 0.45 x best six position-discounted, over it.sig.

fallback._about: Places with no curated appeal: a linear fit on acclaim, beauty and highlights, frozen in the reference (never refit on a normal run), then the frozen per-class curve.

appeal_scale._about: Per-class opening of the curated appeal: [class median, best in class] maps onto [median, ceiling], bent by gamma. The median and best are frozen in the reference.

significance._about: POI significance (score_significance.py): composite of open signals, z-scored on the FROZEN reference mean and spread, placed on the frozen breakpoints (sig 0 to 3), then local quotas give rate 3/2/1.

fame._about: Fame breakpoints (avg daily Wikipedia views per city slot) are frozen in the reference so the hidden-gem flag does not move when places are added.

stability._about: Gate 1: adding places moves no existing score by more than max_move and changes no tier.

nature._about: Nature items on the place ladder (T761, pipeline/nature_tiers.py). Each kind keeps its own parts and weights; a missing part counts at the kind's frozen median and lowers confidence, never renormalised. The blended raw score is placed on a frozen Europe-wide percentile within its kind (breakpoints in the reference's nature part) and read onto the same 0 to 10 cutoffs as places (bands.cutoffs). An item with fewer than min_measured_share of its parts measured gets no score.

ladder._about: Percentile 0 maps to floor, 1 to ceiling; the band starts (1 minus the shares above it) map to bands.cutoffs. The score is floored to one decimal so it never shows a band above its own.

poi_categories._about: The one POI category set (T761): every shipped POI kind maps to exactly one category. Depth reads it; the day planner moves to it in T766. A kind not listed here fails tests/test_poi_labels.py.

poi_labels._about: Three POI labels in place of scores (T761, pipeline/poi_labels.py). Must-see: the highest significance inside the place with at least national recognition, up to the class cap. Recommended: the next POIs by significance inside the place, up to recommended_factor x the cap. Worth a look: any other POI. Inside the place means within depth.poi_own_km of its centre. rate stays on the wire until R4, derived from the label.
